bands.label: U17 academy players' peak match speed is 26.8 +/- 1.9 km/h (mean +/- SD across the study's U17 players, of 180 U13-U17 in all; the band is that SD around the mean, wide for a level's mean)

method: level aggregates pooled over every competition of the level and every measurement season (regista.catalogue.measure: each competition's full double round robin regenerated 6 times). A band passes when the pooled value is inside it. An order step's margin is the higher level's value minus the lower's; its standard error combines the two levels' per-season standard errors; the step passes at 2 standard errors or more the way the source reports, fails as clearly the other way, and is otherwise not separated. The standard errors are conditional on each competition's drawn squads: every measurement season regenerates the same clubs, people and ratings, so they measure match-to-match randomness on those squads, not how much real teams or levels vary, and a step of many standard errors reflects the level scales chosen, not evidence about football.
